modify.small: Only the words inside the quotes need to change.
modify.big: On line 1, replace the word world with your name. On line 2, replace Pip with your name. Leave print, the brackets and the quotes where they are.

make.small: Each line starts with print and an opening bracket, and ends with a closing bracket.
make.big: Write print, then brackets, then your words in quotes inside the brackets. Do that three times on three lines. On one of them, put a comma after the closing quote and add a second piece of text in quotes.
